name: izlearn
description: izLearn — GxP-compliant Learning Management System (21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11 / ALCOA++)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend

//overrides: Transitive pins that a direct dependency will not raise on its own. Keep each entry
WITHIN the parent's declared semver range so nothing breaks, and delete an entry once
the parent ships a fixed version of its own.
@xmldom/xmldom is covered by GHSA-6gmq-8vp8-gcm6 and friends (XML injection, ReDoS,
quadratic parsing) up to 0.8.14. mammoth@1.12.0 declares ^0.8.6 and resolves 0.8.13, and
there is no newer mammoth that raises it, so pin the patched 0.8 release. It MUST stay on
the 0.8 line: 0.9 is a breaking rewrite outside mammoth's declared range, and mammoth's
.docx preview is bundled into the frontend.
Scoped to mammoth rather than global so a future dependency on the 0.9 line is not
silently dragged backwards. (read-excel-file also used to pull xmldom in; 9.3.10 dropped
it for saxen, which is why the frontend pins ^9.3.10 rather than ^9.2.0.)
